step_description: Make repo gofmt-clean to pass rubric item CON-1 (formatter clean).
prompt_text:
You are a remediation agent executing the next Hypergenium roadmap step for this repo.

Context (source of truth):
- Roadmap: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md (Rubric v0.1.0)
- Rubric: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md
- Deterministic verifier: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
- Current failing item: CON-1 (gofmt/formatter clean)
  - Evidence from last run: hgm-infra/evidence/CON-1-output.log lists files not gofmt-clean.

Goal
- Fix ONLY rubric item CON-1 by making the repository gofmt-clean.
- Refresh verifier evidence after the change.

Strict guardrails
- Do NOT change lint rules/configuration (.golangci.yml) or CI workflows.
- Do NOT change go.mod/go.sum (root or example modules) in this step.
- Do NOT address other failing items (COM-1, SEC-1, MAI-1) in this step; record them only if they still fail after re-verification.
- Keep changes mechanical: gofmt-only changes are expected.
- Evidence/notes MUST be written under hgm-infra/.

Allowed write locations
- You MAY modify tracked .go source files as required to satisfy gofmt (this step explicitly requires it).
- You MUST write any new evidence/notes only under hgm-infra/ (prefer hgm-infra/evidence/).

Procedure
1) Reconfirm the current failure (optional but recommended if your workspace may be stale):
   - bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm CON-1 is FAIL and review hgm-infra/evidence/CON-1-output.log for the exact file list.

2) Apply gofmt to the failing files (mechanical formatting only):
   - Use the file list from hgm-infra/evidence/CON-1-output.log.
   - Run: gofmt -w <file1> <file2> ...
   Notes:
   - Do not manually refactor logic.
   - Do not run go mod tidy, go generate, or other code-changing tools beyond gofmt.

3) Validate CON-1 locally before re-running the full verifier:
   - Run a quick gofmt check, e.g.:
     - gofmt -l <same files> (should print nothing)
     - OR re-run: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh (preferred because it records evidence deterministically)

4) Refresh Hypergenium evidence (required):
   - bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   This must regenerate:
   - hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json
   - hgm-infra/evidence/CON-1-output.log (should now indicate gofmt clean / no file list)
   - other evidence logs (they may still show FAIL/BLOCKED for other items; do not fix them in this step).

5) Record a short progress note under hgm-infra/evidence/:
   - Create/update: hgm-infra/evidence/roadmap-progress-M1-CON-1.md
   - Include:
     - Date/time
     - What command(s) were run
     - Summary: CON-1 PASS/FAIL after the final verifier run
     - If CON-1 is still failing, paste the remaining file list (or point to CON-1-output.log).

Deliverable summary to report back
- Confirm whether CON-1 is now PASS (from hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json).
- Provide the path(s) to the refreshed evidence logs.
- Do not include large logs inline; keep full logs in hgm-infra/evidence/*.log and only quote short excerpts if needed.
guardrails: Fix only formatter cleanliness (CON-1); do not attempt other remediation in this step
Do not change go.mod/go.sum (root or examples) in this step
Write new evidence/notes only under hgm-infra/
Modifying .go files is allowed only to apply gofmt (mechanical formatting)
